## Announcement outcome composition

`AnnouncementDeliverySummaryQuery` returns complete retained-message read and route-status aggregates for an explicit Alliance and a bounded map of actual broadcast run/Content subject pairs. All source identifiers must match; no message/delivery sample is presented as a total. Retry candidates have an independent 50-ID cap and a complete count, with current retry authority enforced by the existing mutation Actions. There is no persisted secondary counter or provider outcome authority. [ADR-0050](../../adr/0050-scoped-announcement-outcome-projections.md) defines this contract, query bounds and retention/concurrency limits.

## Announcement outcome diagnostics

The manager's per-run read/status totals aggregate retained Communications records rather than a truncated message/delivery sample. Preparation progress remains Content-owned. A selected retry page contains at most 50 concrete failures below the attempt limit; its separate total includes all current candidates, and the retry Action rechecks current authorization and state. Do not reset attempt counts or infer a provider acknowledgement from preparation completion. The source-scope index is part of the fresh canonical notification schema. Aggregate database work still depends on matching retained volume; monitor query plans and retention growth rather than assuming the response bound guarantees constant scan cost.
